setup_cmd: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3-pip && pip install -U platformio
build_cmd: pio run -e tlora-c6 && cp .pio/build/tlora-c6/firmware-tlora-c6-*.elf .pio/build/tlora-c6/firmware.elf && { cp .pio/build/tlora-c6/firmware-tlora-c6-*.map .pio/build/tlora-c6/firmware.map 2>/dev/null || cp .pio/build/output.map .pio/build/tlora-c6/firmware.map 2>/dev/null || true; }
